verdict.rationale: Honeybadger ties errors to deployments (auto-resolves on deploy, shows errors since last deploy, and links a diff comparison page between deploys), which gives some release-context visibility, but there is no evidence of crash-free sessions/users metrics, per-release adoption tracking, or a canary-vs-stable comparison dashboard as such. missing for 10: crash-free session/user metrics, release adoption percentages, canary vs stable release comparison view.
